set.body:
Give normal grant creation a caller-scoped intent key and a durable replay result. Support the existing grant shapes and a compatible transition for older clients.

Acceptance criteria

1. A retry with the same key and semantic intent, including expiry and an unordered action set, recovers one grant ID and one issuance. Concurrent duplicate submissions have the same result.
2. Reuse of that key for a different recipient, release, action set or expiry conflicts. Independent legitimate grants remain independently attributable and revocable.
3. Following revocation or loss of issuing authority, a replay cannot renew access or disclose a grant outside the caller’s current authority.
4. The production browser uses the same key for a retry of the same submission and a new key for a deliberately new operation.

Verification

Simulate committed response loss, concurrency and revocation in the PostgreSQL HTTP tests and verify grant and audit counts.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: ARC05: Make grant creation retry-safe after a lost response
